title: App authorization reaches the playground
summary:
App authorization, permission-aware model discovery, playground login, and browser-language translation all landed on the same day.

Third-party apps can now send users through an authorization page to sign in, review the requesting app’s hostname, and choose which models it may use. The playground gained Login and Logout controls and uses the current user’s access for image and text generation.

The model-list endpoints now filter results when given a key restricted to certain models. `/v1/models` also returns an OpenAI-compatible list response, changing its previous response schema.

The site added translation for the active page, including lists and News, with an indicator beneath the navigation. English remains the fallback if translation fails.

daily.title: Connect apps with model choice
daily.text: Authorize a third-party app through a redirect, review its hostname, and choose which models it can use. [Connect user wallets](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/connect-user-wallets).

daily.title: Log in to the playground
daily.text: Log in to generate images and text with your own model access. The model selector shows which models your current access enables. [Try the playground](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: Model lists match permissions
daily.text: Model-list endpoints filter results for keys restricted to specific models. `/v1/models` now returns an OpenAI-compatible list response. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Pages in your language
daily.text: Read the active page, including lists and News, in your browser’s language. An indicator shows when translation is in use, and English is the fallback. [Visit pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai).
